title: 아르바이트 면접: 왜 이 일을 하고 싶어요?
objective: Answer common part-time job interview questions and give reasons with -거든요.
summary: A café part-time job interview: reasons, experience, and available times.
setting: A small café near a university. The manager (점장) interviews Maria, an international student, for a part-time job.

task.title: Answer like an applicant
task.line: Use the words and the -거든요 pattern from the dialogue to fill in, choose, order, or write each answer.

words.exampleMeaning: I've worked at a bakery before.
I'm confident handling payments at the counter.
On Saturdays, I can work from the morning.
How much is the hourly pay?
When will the results come out?
If you're going to be late, let us know in advance.

words.meaning: (because) …, you see: gives a reason the listener doesn't know yet
words.exampleMeaning: I can't talk on the phone right now. I'm at work, you see.

dialogue.korean: 마리아 씨죠? 앉으세요. 왜 우리 카페에서 일하고 싶어요?
dialogue.meaning: You're Maria, right? Have a seat. Why do you want to work at our café?

dialogue.korean: 집에서 가깝고, 제가 커피를 정말 좋아하거든요.
dialogue.meaning: It's close to my home, and I really like coffee, you see.
Have you ever worked at a café?

dialogue.korean: 네, 고향에서 1년 동안 카페 아르바이트를 했거든요. 음료 만드는 건 자신 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I worked part-time at a café in my hometown for a year. I'm confident making drinks.

dialogue.korean: 화요일, 목요일 오후하고 주말에 가능해요. 다른 날에는 수업이 있거든요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm available Tuesday and Thursday afternoons and on weekends. I have classes on the other days.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -거든요 (가다): A: 왜 주말에만 일하고 싶어요? B: 평일에는 학교에 ____.
Choose the right word: ① 식당 일은 처음이지만 설거지는 (자신 있어요 / 결과예요). ② 늦으면 미리 (연락 / 결과) 주세요. ③ 저는 밤에도 (가능해요 / 시급이에요).
Answer in Korean with -거든요. You worked at a convenience store in Korea for 6 months: 왜 계산에 자신 있어요?
Put the words in order to ask about pay: 시급은 / 어떻게 / 이 일의 / 돼요?
answers: ① 자신 있어요 ② 연락 ③ 가능해요
한국에서 6개월 동안 편의점에서 일했거든요. (편의점에서 6개월 동안 일했거든요.)
